verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no MSI package, MDM profile, or documented silent-install switches for mass-deploying the Parsec client with preset configuration. The Teams API claim to "automate Parsec deployment" is an API building block for account and computer provisioning, not a packaged client-deployment mechanism. "Installs in seconds" describes a single install, not fleet rollout.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install
